nom: Avène PhysioLift DAY Smoothing Cream, Reduce the Appearance of Deep Wrinkles, Dry Skin, 1 Oz

avis.texte: I have bought this cream before not from Amazon, and I really liked it. This one had a very strange, unpleasant, rotten-like smell. I wouldn't get this from Amazon again.
This cream is ok. It moisturizes well and doesn't aggravate my skin. Not sure if I've seen any big differences from use though.
I love the brand and how smooth is when it goes on. It does not irritate the skin either. One of my favorites.
